environment.description: Same CI pipeline and code, but reports are served through a CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) with Origin Access Control (OAC) configured. The S3 bucket policy restricts access exclusively to the CloudFront distribution's service principal (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) with a Condition on aws:SourceArn matching the distribution ARN. Direct S3 access returns 403. The CloudFront distribution has a custom response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that injects Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self' on ALL responses (including 2xx, 3xx, 4xx). Additionally, the distribution requires signed URLs using a trusted key group (key-group-id: kg-2f8a91bc) — only the CI system's Lambda@Edge function generates valid signatures with 60-second TTL. Unsigned or expired requests receive a 403 from CloudFront before reaching origin. The viewer protocol policy enforces HTTPS-only.

config.origin_access_control: OAC with s3:GetObject condition on distribution ARN
config.s3_bucket_policy: deny all except cloudfront service principal with source ARN condition
config.signed_urls: required, trusted key group kg-2f8a91bc, 60s TTL
